desc: Derive invariant: smoke positions at time t are {P_t - P_k : k in B_t}; campfire empty iff P_t not in birth set
Design O(N) algorithm: prefix displacement + hash set of birth coordinates, answer bit via (P_t - (R,C)) membership, then conditional add of P_t
Confirm ordering subtlety: birth at time t sits at (0,0) ≠ (R,C), so answer/generation order within a step is safe; initial set contains (0,0)
Implement full Python solution with fast I/O and verify against samples
